# Environment Variable Reference

Generated from the annotated `env.example` files. To change a variable, edit its comment block in
the `env.example` file and regenerate this page. Variables marked *(commented out)* are optional
and are disabled in the example file.

### 1. SERVER CONFIGURATION

| Variable | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `PORT` | Number | 3001 | The port the backend server will listen on. |
| `NODE_ENV` | Enum: development \| staging \| production \| test | development | The application environment. |
| `CORS_ORIGIN` | URL | http://localhost:3000 | Allowed origin for CORS headers. |
| `TRUST_PROXY` | Boolean | false | Trust reverse proxy headers (e.g., X-Forwarded-For). Set to true when behind Cloudflare, Nginx, etc. |

### 2. STELLAR & SOROBAN CONFIGURATION

| Variable | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `STELLAR_NETWORK` | Enum: production \| testnet \| standalone | testnet | The Stellar network to connect to. |
| `STELLAR_SECRET_KEY` | String | (None - Generate a secure key for staging/production) | The private key of the Stellar account used by the backend for transactions. |
| `HORIZON_URL` | URL | https://horizon-testnet.stellar.org | The URL of the Horizon server. |
| `SOROBAN_RPC_URL` | URL | https://soroban-testnet.stellar.org | The URL of the Soroban RPC endpoint. |

### 4. DATABASE & CACHE STACK CONFIGURATION

| Variable | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `DATABASE_URL` | String | sqlite::memory: | Database Connection URL. Supports SQLite, PostgreSQL, etc. Example (Postgres): postgres://postgres:postgres@localhost:5432/traqora |
| `REDIS_URL` | URL | redis://localhost:6379 | Redis Connection URL for caching and rate limiting. |
| `MONGO_URI` | String | (None) | MongoDB Connection URI (optional, for specific logging or read-models). |

### 5. SECURITY & JWT CONFIGURATION

| Variable | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `JWT_SECRET` | String | your-secret-key-at-least-32-chars-long | Secret key for signing Access JWTs. Must be at least 32 characters long. |
| `WEBHOOK_SIGNING_SECRET` | String | (falls back to JWT_SECRET) | Secret used to HMAC-sign outbound webhooks (timestamp + nonce + body). Falls back to JWT_SECRET when unset. See packages/backend/src/middleware/webhookVerification.ts. |
| `JWT_EXPIRES_IN` | String | 1h | Expiration time for Access JWTs (e.g., '15m', '1h', '1d'). |
| `JWT_REFRESH_SECRET` | String | your-refresh-secret-at-least-32-chars-long | Secret key for signing Refresh JWTs. Must be at least 32 characters long. |
| `JWT_REFRESH_EXPIRES_IN` | String | 7d | Expiration time for Refresh JWTs (e.g., '7d', '30d'). |
| `ADMIN_API_KEY` | String | dev-admin-key-at-least-16-chars | Admin API Key for accessing administrative endpoints. Must be at least 12 characters. |

| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `LOG_LEVEL` | Enum: debug \| info \| warn \| error | info | Minimum log level. |

### 7. TELEMETRY & OPEN-TELEMETRY (OTEL) TRACING

| Variable | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `ENABLE_TRACING` | Boolean | false | Enable distributed tracing and metric collection. |
| `OTEL_SDK_DISABLED` | Enum: true \| false | true | Disable OpenTelemetry SDK explicitly if needed. |
| `OTEL_SERVICE_NAME` | String | traqora-backend | Service name reported to the OTEL collector. |
| `OTEL_SERVICE_VERSION` | String | 0.1.0 | Version of the service reported. |
| `OTLP_TRACE_URL` | URL | http://localhost:4318/v1/traces | Endpoint to send OpenTelemetry traces. |
| `OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_ENDPOINT` *(commented out)* | URL | (None) | General OTLP collector endpoint. Traces will go to `${OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_ENDPOINT}/v1/traces`. |
| `OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_TRACES_ENDPOINT` *(commented out)* | URL | (None) | Specific OTLP trace exporter endpoint (standard OTEL variable). |
| `OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_TRACES_HEADERS` *(commented out)* | String | (None) | Custom headers for OTLP trace exporter (format: key1=value1,key2=value2). |
| `OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_HEADERS` *(commented out)* | String | (None) | Custom headers for OTLP trace exporter (format: key1=value1,key2=value2). |
| `TRACING_SAMPLE_RATE` | Number: 0.0 to 1.0 | 1.0 | Trace sampling rate. 1.0 means 100% of traces are captured. |
| `OTEL_TRACES_SAMPLER_ARG` *(commented out)* | Number: 0.0 to 1.0 | 1.0 | Trace sampling rate. 1.0 means 100% of traces are captured. |

| `SENTRY_ORG` *(commented out)* | String | (None) | Sentry org/project/auth token — only needed to upload source maps on build. |
| `SENTRY_PROJECT` *(commented out)* | String | (None) | Sentry org/project/auth token — only needed to upload source maps on build. |
| `SENTRY_AUTH_TOKEN` *(commented out)* | String | (None) | Sentry org/project/auth token — only needed to upload source maps on build. |

| Variable | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `RATE_LIMIT_MAX` | Number | 1000 | General maximum number of requests per window. |
| `RATE_LIMIT_WINDOW_SEC` | Number | 60 | Rate limit window in seconds. |
| `RATE_LIMIT_PUBLIC_MAX` | Number | 100 | Max requests per window for public endpoints. |
| `RATE_LIMIT_USER_MAX` | Number | 300 | Max requests per window for standard authenticated users. |
| `RATE_LIMIT_PREMIUM_MAX` | Number | 1000 | Max requests per window for premium users. |
| `DDOS_BURST_MAX` | Number | 250 | Maximum burst rate before triggering DDOS defense. |
| `DDOS_BURST_WINDOW_SEC` | Number | 60 | DDOS burst window in seconds. |
| `RATE_LIMIT_BLOCK_DURATION_SEC` | Number | 900 (15 minutes) | Duration in seconds a blocked IP will remain blacklisted. |
| `RATE_LIMIT_BLOCK_AFTER_VIOLATIONS` | Number | 5 | Number of rate-limit violations before blocking an IP. |
| `CAPTCHA_AFTER_VIOLATIONS` | Number | 3 | Number of violations before requiring CAPTCHA verification. |
| `USE_CLOUDFLARE_HEADERS` | Boolean | false | Parse Cloudflare headers (CF-Connecting-IP) for client IP. |
